employees.label: Employees (Company scope)
employees.definition: ESG report 'Number of employees by geographic region'. Covers permanent employees of the Company, which the report defines as the Group Headquarters and its directly managed wholly-owned subsidiaries, excluding Tencent Music Entertainment Group and China Literature Limited (87,412 total; consultants and interns, 5,566, are counted separately and not included); the group total in the annual report is 115,849.

notes: The 2025 annual report gives only the group headcount (115,849 at Dec 31, 2025, including subsidiaries and consolidated investment companies) with no geographic split. The 2025 ESG report splits a narrower Company-scope headcount into 'Chinese Mainland' (85,460) and 'Others' (1,952), total 87,412 permanent employees. Its scope was expanded in 2025 to the Group Headquarters and directly managed wholly-owned subsidiaries (excluding Tencent Music and China Literature) and 2024 was restated (81,740), so the figures are not comparable with the 58,350 in the 2024 report. 'Others' is not defined by country, so it is a region with countries null, labelled here as outside the Mainland of China. No province-level, country-level tax or site counts are published. The Tianjin Binhai data centre is not mentioned in the 2025 ESG report; that site is kept on the 2024 ESG report (still online on 2026-11-24).
